title: POS Purchase Example
applicability: Example-driven POS purchase scenario containing Segment 100 and Product Code Segment 102.

businessRequirements.title: A POS purchase request identifies ATL105 and declares the serialized segment count in Data Section 1.
A POS purchase request contains Segment 100 with Segment Type 100 and encoded Segment Length.
A POS purchase Prompt Code identifies purchase/capture transaction type 0 and the applicable card type.
Segment 100 fuel, nonfuel, tax, and cash amounts represent the transaction totals and agree with product data where applicable.
A POS purchase with fuel and product detail includes Product Code Segment 102 and preserves product order and delimiters.
The sum of Product Code Segment 102 product amounts agrees with the applicable Segment 100 amounts.

testCases.positive: ATL105 POS purchase with Segment 100 and declared count 03
Fuel and nonfuel product amounts agree with Segment 100 totals

testDataStatus: Existing Segment 100 message-length, identity, and compatibility packages cover the underlying rules; the Appendix B example should be retained as a composite scenario fixture.
